name: CUDA-OpenGL Interoperability
aliases: OpenGL-CUDA Interoperability via Pixel Buffer Object (PBO)
definition: A technique to render volume data by computing ray casting on the GPU (CUDA) and writing the final image directly into a texture that is registered with OpenGL, avoiding CPU-GPU data transfer for the final image.
summary: CUDA-OpenGL Interoperability enables zero-copy GPU memory sharing between CUDA kernels and the OpenGL pipeline, bypassing CPU-mediated transfers to boost real-time volume rendering frame rates.
